cues.en: Hello and welcome to this new section on classification, very exciting.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到新的分類章節，非常精彩。

cues.en: Classification is a very popular and important tool in machine learning, so I'm super excited to get started.
cues.zh: 分類是熱門、重要的機器學習工具，很期待開始。

cues.en: Let's have a look.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: All right, so classification can be defined as a machine learning technique to identify the category of new observations based on training data.
cues.zh: 分類可定義為：根據訓練資料，辨識新觀測資料所屬類別的機器學習技術。

cues.en: This is different to regression where we had to predict a continuous number.
cues.zh: 不同於迴歸預測連續數值。

cues.en: Here we use classification to predict a category.
cues.zh: 這裡預測的是類別。

cues.en: Another important thing is that it's a type of supervised learning algorithm.
cues.zh: 另一點，它屬於監督式學習演算法。

cues.en: We'll discuss this a bit more when we reach the next section on clustering.
cues.zh: 下一節分群會進一步討論。

cues.en: And there are actually a variety of applications of classification from medicine to marketing to business, and lots of different areas.
cues.zh: 從醫療、行銷到商業等，分類有各式應用。

cues.en: Let's have a look at a few.
cues.zh: 看幾個例子。

cues.en: So for example, you have customers of a business and you would like to predict which ones are likely to stay and which ones are likely to leave.
cues.zh: 例如想預測企業的哪些顧客可能留下，哪些可能離開。

cues.en: This is also called churn modeling.
cues.zh: 也叫顧客流失建模。

cues.en: Very important because if you can predict which customers are likely to leave your business in the next month or six months, then you can take actions
cues.zh: 很重要，因為如果能預測未來一個月或六個月誰會離開，就能採取行動，

cues.en: and send them special offers or ask them about their feedback and make certain changes so that they stay.
cues.zh: 提供特別優惠、詢問意見或做改變，讓他們留下。

cues.en: So it's a very powerful tool for businesses.
cues.zh: 對企業是很強大的工具。

cues.en: Another application is email.
cues.zh: 另一個應用是電子郵件。

cues.en: So for instance, if you get an email, it might be classified as normal mail or it might be classified as important and urgent mail, it might have a special marker,
cues.zh: 收到郵件時，可能分類為一般郵件，或重要、緊急郵件，加特別標記，

cues.en: especially if you using Gmail, you'll see those little chevrons or triangles at the beginning of a message saying that it's important or it might be categorized
cues.zh: 尤其 Gmail，會看到訊息開頭的小箭頭或三角形，表示重要，也可能分類為

cues.en: as a promotion and it might be put into a separate folder so it's not filling up your main inbox, which you use for work.
cues.zh: 促銷，放進獨立資料夾，避免塞滿工作用主收件匣。

cues.en: Or it might be categorized as spam.
cues.zh: 或分類成垃圾郵件。

cues.en: So spam filters have become very good over the past few years.
cues.zh: 近年垃圾郵件過濾器變得很好。

cues.en: We barely see any spam in our inboxes, and that is thanks to classification algorithms.
cues.zh: 收件匣幾乎看不到垃圾郵件，這要歸功於分類演算法。

cues.en: And another application is image recognition.
cues.zh: 另一應用是影像辨識。

cues.en: So for instance, here we have images of dogs and cats, classification would be able to separate dogs from cats.
cues.zh: 例如這裡貓狗影像，分類能區分狗與貓。

cues.en: So those are just a few examples.
cues.zh: 只是幾個例子。

cues.en: As you can see, it's a very powerful tool.
cues.zh: 可以看到很強大。

cues.en: There are lots of algorithms that fall into this family of classification in machine learning, and they have a variety of applications.
cues.zh: 機器學習裡，分類家族有許多演算法，也有各種應用。

cues.en: So I'm very excited to explore this section further with you together and until next time, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 期待一起深入這節，下次見，在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
